guardrails: Cite first-party, diocesan and institute evidence for independently reviewed existing physical identities; do not treat archive slugs as a current LMD source of Mass times.

Church address, mail/office address, and contact location must be independently classified rather than reused as coordinates.
The wider 281 single candidates remain unverified until separately owner-confirmed; these five are a subset, not five additional archive positions.
